why: What changes, where, what an expired link shows and what must keep working are all stated, and both criteria can be tried.

contract.title: Expire password reset links after 30 minutes
contract.details:
Make the password reset links that the Quillmoor members site sends expire 30 minutes after they are sent.

Today a reset link never expires. An expired link opens a page that says This link has expired, with a button that sends a new link. A link that was already used keeps being refused, as it is now.

criteria.text: A reset link opened 31 minutes after it was sent shows This link has expired and does not let the password be changed.
A reset link opened within 30 minutes still lets the member set a new password.
